name: Hodge uniqueness lemma
statement: Given g_obs, orientation, and volume form, alpha wedge *_obs beta = <alpha,beta>_g_obs vol_obs uniquely fixes *_obs.
guard: Does not by itself prove parent-visible EM action uses *_obs.

name: Delta_Hodge zero theorem
statement: If the parent-visible EM action contains only F wedge *_obs F and forbids independent chi_EM, hidden/disformal EM metrics, skewon/dissipative pieces, active axion gradients, and readout-regenerated Hodge maps, then Delta_Hodge_EM=0.
guard: Blocked by unsigned action-domain and constitutive-absence clauses.

name: conformal/scale guard
statement: In four dimensions the Hodge star on two-forms is conformally invariant, so Hodge closure does not fix Z_Q, mu0, alpha_EM, charge normalization, source mass, or G_N.
